title: Hood Feminism
author: Mikki Kendall
summary: Mikki Kendall argues that mainstream feminism has neglected issues like hunger, housing, safety and education that matter most to many women of colour, and calls for a broader agenda.
readIf: you want a direct, accessible challenge to how feminism sets its priorities.
skipIf: you want a research monograph, since these are punchy, opinionated essays.
